title: 🔗 Перевод и предложение
description: Соедини русское предложение с его английским переводом. Обрати внимание на наречия частотности!

columns.label: My friend uses the Internet every day.
We often go to the sports club after school.
My sister sometimes watches films in the evenings.
I never play computer games at night.
Teenagers often listen to music on headphones.
We rarely go to the cinema at the weekend.
My brother usually does his homework in the living room.
Our classmates live near the school.
I often chat with my friends online.
My cousin plays the guitar in a band.
We sometimes visit our relatives in the country.
My dad always reads the newspaper in the morning.
My mum often cooks a tasty dinner.

items.verb: Мой друг каждый день пользуется интернетом.
